Name: PSMAgent
Description: PSM Agent (Powershell Scripts Management): a small HTTPS web service on each PSM server (Pode + Pode.Web) that shows this server's PSM data: device record, applications and their settings layers, logs and cleanup list. Read-only. Bump Version whenever a file of this application changes.

Notes.Port: 8776 = PSM on a telephone keypad. Opened in Windows Firewall for the Domain profile by Install-PsmAgent.ps1.
Notes.ViewGroups: AD groups (nested membership counts) whose members can sign in and view. AdminGroups can also view, and later use actions.
Notes.Certificate: The newest valid server-authentication certificate in LocalMachine\My for this server's FQDN; one whose issuer contains PreferIssuer (the internal CA, auto-enrolled) wins. Without one, AllowSelfSigned starts with a self-signed certificate and logs a warning.
Notes.Modules: Installed on the servers by SetupApplications (Install-ServerModule; downloaded on the workstation, no internet needed on the server).
